te: State agencies on data centres, and progress on SMR and waste
se: The subcommittee on price and power sector structures heard state agencies on the data centre business, such as the Board of Investment, the Eastern Economic Corridor Office and EGAT, while the subcommittees on laws for new alternative energy and on community waste set their next meetings.
it: The data centre business (BOI, EEC, EGAT)
Meeting dates of the SMR and waste subcommittees

te: SMR and the military, data centre proposals, and community waste power
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard the Defence Energy Department on promoting SMR technology. The subcommittee on price and power sector structures summarised points on data centres, such as creating a special electricity user category for data centres, which now pay the same rates as ordinary buildings, and the new subcommittee on community waste management for electricity set its meetings.
it: SMR and energy missions (Defence Energy Department)
A special electricity user category for data centres
Subcommittee on community waste for electricity

te: How much electricity do data centres use?
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy set a meeting on developing SMR, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures began studying the data centre business in Thailand, hearing an academic from King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang.
it: Plan to study SMR development
The data centre business in Thailand (KMITL academic)

te: Developing SMR, and a complaint about a 500 kV power line
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy studied ways to develop SMR technology in Thailand, hearing agencies such as the Eastern Economic Corridor Office, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures considered a complaint asking for a check of the approval of a 500 kV transmission line linking a private power plant in Chachoengsao.
it: Ways to develop SMR technology
Complaint about a 500 kV transmission line, Chachoengsao

te: Geology and earthquakes in choosing SMR sites, and electricity on state property land
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning and the Department of Mineral Resources on geological and earthquake criteria for choosing sites, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures discussed with the Office of the National Land Policy Board and the Treasury Department how to give people access to electricity on state property land in Pran Buri District, Prachuap Khiri Khan.
it: Geological and earthquake criteria for choosing sites (Department of Mineral Resources)
Access to electricity on state property land, Prachuap Khiri Khan (National Land Policy Board, Treasury Department)

te: Renewing biomass power contracts, and bamboo as an energy crop
se: The committee considered how to manage the renewal of power purchase contracts for biomass power plants and plans to promote bamboo as an energy crop to supply them. DEDE reported that it has presented the information to the Minister of Energy, who has approved it.
it: Renewing power purchase contracts for biomass power plants (DEDE)
Promoting bamboo as an energy crop

te: Public electricity bills, and power problems on state land
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy set further meetings on SMR policy, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures considered ways to pay for public electricity, such as using agencies' other income, which is limited by rules on remitting state revenue, and planned to invite the Office of the National Land Policy Board to discuss solving electricity problems on state land.
it: Ways to pay public electricity bills
Access to electricity on state land (Office of the National Land Policy Board to be invited)

te: SMR policy with EPPO, and TIS standards for solar panels
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard EPPO on the overall policy to promote SMR technology in the energy sector, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures studied the criteria and steps for obtaining Thai Industrial Standards (TIS) certification for solar panels.
it: Policy to promote SMR technology (EPPO)
Criteria for TIS certification of solar panels

te: Criteria for including SMR in the power plan, and the one-stop government services report
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy reported on criteria for including small modular reactor (SMR) technology in the draft PDP, the commercial operation date and public communication plans, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures summarised proposed changes to its report on complete one-stop government services (One-Stop-Service).
it: Criteria for including SMR in the draft PDP
Changes to the One-Stop-Service report for energy

te: SMR in the power plan, and improving the report on one-stop government services
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy reported on the share of SMR in the PDP, the commercial operation date and public communication plans, which EPPO is working on. The committee proposed changes to the One-Stop-Service report, such as renaming it “complete one-stop government services” and adding the licensing steps before and after amending secondary laws.
it: SMR in the PDP and public communication plans
Proposed changes to the One-Stop-Service report

te: Scope of the SMR law study, and the draft report on one-stop energy services
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy set the scope of its study of policy and laws for developing small modular reactor (SMR) technology, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures considered its draft report on one-stop approvals and permits (One-Stop-Service).
it: Scope of the study of laws and regulations on SMR
Draft report on One-Stop-Service for energy

te: Electricity for Border Patrol Police schools in remote areas
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy reported its first meeting to set its work, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures reported on three Border Patrol Police schools in Prachuap Khiri Khan, which are in remote areas and still have electricity problems.
it: Work plan of the subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy
Electricity for three Border Patrol Police schools, Prachuap Khiri Khan

te: Fewer steps for power generation licences: Ror.Ngor.4 type 88 and Phor.Khor.2
se: The committee followed the removal of power plants (factory type 88) from the ministerial regulation list, whose draft regulation is before the Cabinet, with concerns from the Department of Industrial Works about environmental standards and the ERC's readiness, and followed the cancellation of the controlled-energy production licence (Phor.Khor.2) under the Energy Development and Promotion Act B.E. 1992, which now applies to generators of 200 kVA and above.
it: Cancelling Ror.Ngor.4 for power plants (factory type 88) (ERC)
Cancelling the controlled-energy production licence (Phor.Khor.2) (DEDE)

te: New subcommittees: laws on new alternative energy, and future power price structures
se: The chair reported that the subcommittee on laws and regulations for new alternative energy will hold its first meeting on 10 June 2026. The hydrogen subcommittee planned to invite EPPO, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures for the future set its tasks, such as a report on options to lower electricity prices, one-stop services for energy such as removing factory type 88 and the controlled-energy production licence (Phor.Khor.2) for solar, and extending power lines in Prachuap Khiri Khan.
it: Subcommittee on laws and regulations for new alternative energy (first meeting set)
Tasks on price and power sector structures for the future
One-stop services for energy: factory type 88 and the Phor.Khor.2 licence

te: Getting ready for hydrogen and ammonia, and restructuring the power sector
se: The hydrogen subcommittee reported on preparing for hydrogen and ammonia, with information from the ERC and other agencies, and the committee considered a new task: studying and following the restructuring of the power sector, covering generation, transmission, distribution and users, for a secure and well-run power system.
it: Preparing for hydrogen and ammonia
Scope for studying and following power sector restructuring

te: Two subcommittees finish their terms, and a new one on SMR is prepared
se: The renewable energy and electricity prices subcommittees reported that they have completed their terms. The committee will prepare a new subcommittee to study renewable energy and laws on small modular reactors (SMR), and is considering its members.
it: Renewable energy and electricity prices subcommittees complete their terms
Preparing a subcommittee on renewable energy and SMR laws
